comments.author: coldtea
comments.story: Houston, We Have A Public Domain Problem
comments.why: Ellison's 'pay the writer' as the obligatory link
comments.text: > Is art, similarly to science, not an iterative process based on the input of dozens, hundreds, thousands of people that came before us? Are we all not standing on the shoulders of giants, pushing just a few steps forward more, both because we like what came before us but want to see it go someplace new? Yes, and a lot of us want to be paid for our contributions to this mass endeavour. Case in point, lots of those giants on whose shoulders we stand got ripped off and died peniless. Obligatory link: [VIDEO] (Harlan Elisson, "Pay the writer").
